gaps.sentence: Profits rose ___ 40 per cent, far beyond even the optimistic forecasts.
gaps.explanation: 'By' expresses the size of the increase: rose by 40 per cent.

gaps.sentence: ___ the exception of the organ, every instrument in the chapel is original.
The new policy was introduced ___ response to rising demand.
gaps.explanation: 'in response to' = as a reaction to.

gaps.sentence: ___ contrast to her sister, she loves publicity.
The guests arrived ___ ones and twos rather than all at once.
gaps.hint: in ___ and ___ = a few at a time
gaps.explanation: 'In ones and twos' = a small number at a time.'

gaps.sentence: I'm in no ___ — take your time deciding.
Everything was left ___ the care of the next-door neighbours.
gaps.explanation: 'In the care of' = looked after by.'

gaps.sentence: The play closed after three nights ___ account of poor ticket sales.
gaps.explanation: 'On account of' = because of, in a formal register.
